# Getty Images

> > Getty Images is the world's leading provider of royalty-free stock photos, creative images, vectors, and generative AI tools for commercial and editorial use.

Getty Images offers a comprehensive platform for licensing high-resolution imagery across multiple categories including seasonal content, holiday themes, technology, and cultural topics. The platform provides subscription-based access to millions of stock photos, creative assets, and AI-powered image generation and modification tools with legal protections for commercial use.

- [Creative Images](https://www.gettyimages.com/creative-images): Creative images collection including royalty-free photos, vectors, and editorial content

## Seasonal & Holiday Content

- [Spring Stock Photos](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/spring): Spring seasonal stock photos with royalty-free imagery and high resolution
- [Easter Stock Photos](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/easter): Easter seasonal stock photos with holiday themes and high-resolution imagery
- [Easter Sunday Stock Photos](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/easter-sunday): Easter Sunday religious and family celebration stock photo collection
- [Good Friday Stock Photos](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/good-friday): Good Friday and Easter religious holiday stock photo collection
- [Passover Stock Photos](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/passover): Passover holiday stock photos including Seder and Jewish celebration imagery
- [Yom Haatzmaut Stock Photos](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/yom-haatzmaut): Israel Independence Day and Yom Haatzmaut celebration stock photos
- [Women's History Month Stock Photos](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/womens-history-month): Women's History Month stock photos and cultural imagery collection
- [Calendar Stock Photos](https://www.gettyimages.com/stock-photos/calendar): Calendar stock photos, vectors, and icons for various holiday seasons

## Specialized Categories

- [AI Stock Photos](https://www.gettyimages.com/photos/ai): Artificial intelligence and machine learning concept stock photos collection
